description: Run an APPROVED script on many profiles for real. Returns the run IMMEDIATELY; its `id` is the run_id for get_run_result. Unlike run_script (a trial on at most 3 profiles, no approval needed), the script must have been approved by the user in Veilus → Flow, otherwise the call is refused. A profile id that does not exist is counted as a failed profile of the run, not rejected (unlike create_schedule, which refuses unknown ids with 404). concurrency (default 3, 1-16, capped by get_capacity's `max`) is how many profiles run at once; stagger_ms (default 1500, 0-600000 i.e. 10 minutes) is the pause between launches; use get_capacity to choose.

variables.description: Variables for this run, read as process.env.VEILUS_VAR_<NAME>

name: run_batch
